'''Elom''' was the native [[Language/Legends|language]] of the [[Elom/Legends|Elom]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]].<ref name="u">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref>

The structure of the Eloms' [[Mouth/Legends|mouths]] was quite different from [[Human/Legends|Human's]], so their language was also different. In fact, it was very difficult for Eloms to learn [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]].<ref name="u" />
